name: Mangesh Bide
headline: Software Engineer — Backend & Applied AI
summary: Software engineer working across backend and applied AI, building production healthcare systems with Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Led a greenfield authentication and authorization platform from architecture through production deployment using self-hosted Keycloak, custom Java SPIs, OIDC, multi-tenant SSO with IdP federation, and SpiceDB-based ReBAC. Owns backend architecture and infrastructure end-to-end, with additional experience building real-time voice and agentic AI systems.

bullets: Led a greenfield authentication and authorization platform end-to-end, owning architecture, authorization modeling, service integration, rollout, and production deployment.

Built and operated self-hosted Keycloak in production, including deployment, configuration, upgrades, backups, and operational maintenance; developed custom Java SPIs, providers, and extensions for business-specific identity requirements.

Designed fine-grained authorization using SpiceDB (Google Zanzibar model), defining a ReBAC model spanning 16 object types and 45 permissions and integrating authorization checks across Django/DRF APIs.

Implemented multi-tenancy with Keycloak Organizations and tenant-aware authentication; built IdP Federation with domain-based SSO to route users to their enterprise identity provider based on email domain.

Kept the SpiceDB authorization graph consistent with PostgreSQL using a transactional outbox and asynchronous worker, with reconciliation and consistency mechanisms to detect and repair authorization drift.

Architected a real-time multilingual voice transcription and translation pipeline in a production EHR, streaming audio through Azure Speech into structured clinical records in PostgreSQL and serving 1,000+ patients.

Own the backend stack (Django, DRF, PostgreSQL, AWS) handling 10K–100K requests/day; designed production infrastructure with Terraform, Docker, and AWS EC2 and GitHub Actions CI/CD, reducing deployment time from ~45 min to ~12 min (~70%).

Set up observability with Sentry, ClickHouse, and Grafana; migrated legacy Django views to DRF ViewSets (~40% less boilerplate), write Pytest unit/integration tests, review code, and ship React.js/Next.js features end-to-end.
Built full-stack production features using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and NestJS; containerized services with Docker and provisioned cloud infrastructure with Terraform.
Designed REST APIs using Django and MySQL with JWT authentication and RBAC for a Flutter activity-tracking application; integrated ML-powered image search and OTP/email verification.

projects.name: Mira — Voice Front-Desk Agent
bullets: Built a real-time conversational AI agent with Daily/WebRTC voice interaction, avatar, 7 booking tools, slot-conflict and idempotency guards, 10 unit tests, and Gemini-generated call summaries.

projects.name: Fieldnotes — Agentic Job Research System
bullets: Built a multi-stage planner–executor–synthesizer agent that researches companies, inspects GitHub engineering footprints, compares resume embeddings against job requirements, and returns structured apply/consider/skip verdicts with cost and latency observability.

projects.name: HIPAA Guardian
bullets: Built a PHI/PII detection engine that scans source, data files, logs, and API responses for all 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers, scores each finding's confidence, maps it to the relevant HIPAA rule, and writes an audit report a reviewer can act on; excludes known-safe patterns (never-issued SSN ranges, 555-01xx numbers, example.com) to keep false positives low on real codebases.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (ECS, EC2, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, Cognito, CloudWatch)
